email_body:
Dear Gwendoline,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Growth Marketer position at Spotable, as advertised. Your focus on building a scalable growth engine through measurable acquisition and activation deeply resonates with my profile as a data-driven digital marketer.

My experience includes managing SEO and Google Ads campaigns, running technical SEO/GEO audits, and leveraging AI tools for content and search visibility. I am adept at analyzing performance using Google Analytics and Search Console, and consistently aim for measurable results in user acquisition and engagement. The prospect of exploring new AI-powered advertising channels and optimizing funnels from ad to activation at Spotable is particularly exciting.

I have successfully grown organic traffic for client websites and measurably improved search health scores through iterative experiments, reflecting my hands-on approach to identifying what truly works. I am eager to contribute to Spotable's expansion and help turn marketing activity into tangible business growth.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Growth Marketer position at Spotable, an opportunity that aligns perfectly with my expertise in driving measurable growth through a blend of digital marketing and technical acumen. Your innovative approach to supporting roofing and façade contractors with AI-powered solutions, coupled with a clear emphasis on experimentation and data-driven results, presents an inspiring environment where I am confident I can make a significant contribution.

My background as a digital marketer has consistently involved optimizing acquisition channels and analyzing performance to drive activation. At Episto, I managed on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, consistently tracking results with tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to grow organic traffic. My Google Ads Search Certification further equips me to manage and optimize paid campaigns for qualified traffic and signups. I thrive on translating analytical insights into concrete actions that enhance conversion rates and user acquisition across the funnel.

The prospect of exploring and testing new acquisition channels, including AI-assisted advertising, is particularly exciting given my daily use of LLMs for research, content, and prompt engineering. As a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt, running iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised a site’s search-health score. This experience, combined with my proficiency in building and optimizing WordPress sites for content and conversion, demonstrates my hands-on approach to running growth experiments and optimizing landing pages. I am also comfortable writing and testing marketing copy in both Dutch and English.

I am eager to bring my analytical, entrepreneurial, and hands-on approach to Spotable, helping to build a scalable growth engine and directly influence user acquisition and activation. My commitment to understanding the 'why' behind campaign performance and continuously improving results makes me a strong candidate for this role. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Google Ads Search Certification and proven ability to analyze campaign performance and acquisition funnels using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs.
• Expertise in GEO & AEO (AI search visibility), llms.txt implementation, knowledge-graph markup, and daily use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for research and content.
• Track record of running iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised search-health scores and successfully growing organic traffic for client websites.
• Hands-on experience in building and optimizing WordPress websites, managing CMS content, and implementing structured data for improved user acquisition.
• Ability to write and test marketing copy in English (Fluent) and Dutch (Writing B1), supporting market expansion initiatives.
